title.en: MALACAÑANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES ADJUSTING THE DIVIDEND RATE OF THE DEVELOPMENT BANK OF THE PHILIPPINES (DBP ON ITS 2001 and 2002 NET EARNINGS
title.orig: MALACAÑANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES ADJUSTING THE DIVIDEND RATE OF THE DEVELOPMENT BANK OF THE PHILIPPINES (DBP ON ITS 2001 and 2002 NET EARNINGS

text.en:
The percentage of dividends for year 2001 to be remitted
by DBP to the National Government is adiusted to at least seven hundred fifty
five million pesos (P755 M) or equivalent to 25% net earnings.

The percentage of dividends for year 2002 to be remitted by DBP
to the National Government is adiusted to at least one billion pesos (P1 B) or
equivalent to 23% of its 2002 net earnings.
PaM) Hologram # 19324

-2 -

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 21st day of April
year of our Lord, two thousand and three.
By the President:
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
POMP Hologram * 19325
